notes.title: Notice Regarding Update Schedule and Project Transfer
notes.notes: [p]Hello.[/p][p]This is the Princess Maker: Children of Prophecy development team.[/p][p][/p][p]First, we would like to offer our sincere apologies to everyone who has been waiting for the September update.[/p][p]Currently, our project is preparing for a transfer to an external company to continue development.[/p][p]Due to this, the originally scheduled September and October updates are in an uncertain state, and we sincerely apologize once again to everyone who has been waiting.[/p][p]We continue to work hard to complete the project somehow, and we are doing our best to find a way to continue development even in the current situation.[/p][p]We sincerely apologize for causing worry and confusion, and we will share future progress as quickly and accurately as possible to avoid any further confusion.[/p][p]Thank you.[/p]

notes.title: Additional Fixes and Future Plans
notes.notes:
[p]We have made additional fixes for some typos and reported errors.[/p][p]
Currently, we have established the foundation for 8-year gameplay,[/p][p]and we plan to proceed with a major update within September.[/p][p][/p][p]The entire development team is working with full effort towards the September update goal,[/p][p]and we will continue to keep you informed about our progress.[/p][p][/p][p]We sincerely thank you for your continued interest and support.[/p]

notes.title: Feedback-Based Hotfix
notes.notes:
[p]We sincerely thank you for all the feedback you've sent us since yesterday's Early Access release.[/p][p]We've proceeded with a patch for the parts that urgently needed fixing.[/p][p][/p][p]Patch Contents[/p][list][*][p]Windowed mode resolution refinement[/p][/*][*][p]Relaxed basic job ending conditions[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed GPU load issue in ending collection[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some speaker display errors[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Although the game still has many shortcomings,[/p][p]we thank all of you who played it once again,[/p][p]and we will continue to listen to your valuable feedback and make improvements.[/p][p]
Thank you.[/p]

notes.title: Early Access Release
notes.notes: [p]Princess Maker: Children of Revelation Early Access version has been released.[/p][p][/p][p](Steam Deck and gamepad support are also available.)[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks to your generous support, we've been able to come this far.[/p][p]We will continue to fill in the missing content one by one,[/p][p]and do our best to develop it into a better game.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you once again from the bottom of our hearts.[/p]
